setup.title: Stock setup
setup.description: Units, items, warehouses and who keeps them. Master data shared by the whole organisation.

unit.name: Name
unit.wholeOnlyHelp: Tick for things counted in whole pieces (bags, pcs). Leave clear for lengths, weights and volumes.

item.name: Name
item.leadTimeHelp: Optional. Used later to suggest reorder levels.

warehouse.name: Name
warehouse.projectHelp: Optional. Only a default for issues; it does not restrict them.

states.errorSub: The request failed. Check your connection and try again.

emptyUnits.title: No units yet
emptyUnits.sub: Add the units you count stock in, such as bag, metre or kilogram.

emptyItems.title: No items yet
emptyItems.sub: Add the materials you keep in stock. Each one needs a unit.

emptyWarehouses.title: No warehouses yet
emptyWarehouses.sub: Add a central store and your site stores.

states.readOnlyHint: You can view stock setup. Project Managers and above can change it.

confirm.archiveDescription: It disappears from new documents. Existing history stays. An item with stock on hand cannot be archived.

keepersPanel.title: Keepers
keepersPanel.subtitle: Keepers post receipts, transfers and issues for this warehouse.

errors.STK_INSUFFICIENT: Not enough stock on hand for this movement.
errors.STK_NOT_KEEPER: Only a keeper of this warehouse can do this.
errors.STK_OWNED_BY_ERP: Stock is managed in your accounting system, so it cannot be changed here.
errors.STK_SELF_APPROVE: You cannot approve your own adjustment.
errors.STK_RANK: Your role is not allowed to do this.
errors.STK_PROJECT_NOT_ACTIVE: The project is not active, so stock cannot be issued to it.
errors.STK_BOQ_MISMATCH: That work item does not belong to the project.
errors.STK_RETURN_EXCEEDS: You cannot return more than was issued.
errors.STK_FRACTION: This unit only allows whole numbers.
errors.STK_BACKDATE: That date is too far back or in the future.
errors.STK_HAS_STOCK: Stock is still on hand, so this cannot be archived.
errors.STK_UNIT_LOCKED: This unit is already used by stock documents, so it cannot be changed.
errors.STK_INVALID: Some of the details are not valid.
errors.STK_NOT_FOUND: That record was not found in your organisation.
errors.STK_TOO_MANY: Too many rows to show. Narrow the filter.
errors.STK_KIND_UNAVAILABLE: This kind of document is not available yet.
errors.STK_IMMUTABLE: A posted or cancelled document cannot be changed.
errors.STK_STALE: This draft changed since you opened it. Review the new version, then post.
errors.STK_INSUFFICIENT_DETAIL: Only {{available}} on hand; you asked for {{requested}}.

states.errorSub: Check your connection and try again. Nothing was changed.

onHand.title: Stock on hand
onHand.description: What every warehouse holds right now. Open an item to see how it got there.

states.noMatchSub: Clear the search or pick another warehouse.
states.emptySub: Receive stock into a warehouse and it appears here.

documents.title: Stock documents
documents.description: Every receipt, transfer, issue and return, newest first.

states.emptySub: Receive stock into a warehouse to create the first one.
states.noMatchSub: Clear a filter to see more.

notFound.title: Document not found
notFound.sub: It may belong to another organisation or no longer exist.

detail.noEntries: Nothing has been posted for this document.

confirm.title: Cancel this draft?
confirm.description: The draft is kept for the record but can no longer be posted.

ledger.title: Stock ledger
ledger.description: Every posting: who, when, which project and work item, and the balance after it.

states.emptySub: Postings appear here the moment they are made.
states.noMatchSub: Clear a filter to see more.

materials.title: Materials
materials.description: Material used by this project per month and against its allowances, with who issued it.

form.unknownKindSub: Use Receive, Transfer, Issue, Return, Stock count or Adjustment from the Stock page.

intro.receive: Book goods into a warehouse you keep.
intro.transfer: Move stock between two warehouses in one step.
intro.issue: Take stock out of a warehouse onto a project work item.
intro.return: Put unused stock back, citing the issue it came from.

form.unitCostBlind: Unit cost (you will not see it again)
form.viewOnly: You are viewing as another role, so nothing can be posted.
form.notKeeper: Only a keeper of this warehouse can post here.

noWarehouse.title: You keep no warehouse
noWarehouse.sub: Ask an administrator to make you a keeper of a warehouse.

errors.toWarehouse: Choose a different warehouse to receive the stock.
errors.source: Choose the issue line you are returning.
errors.quantity: Enter a quantity above zero (up to 3 decimals).
errors.unitCost: Enter the unit cost (zero or more).

intro.count: Count what is on the shelf. The system quantity is shown beside each line.
intro.adjustment: Correct stock for damage, loss or a find, with a reason.

count.reasonHelp: For example: damaged, lost, found in the yard.
count.costDefault: Leave empty to use the average cost.
count.anotherPerson: Another person must post this: a Project Manager or above who did not write it.
count.onHandFailed: Couldn't load the quantities on hand

notEditable.title: This document can't be edited
notEditable.sub: Only a draft adjustment or count can be reopened.

errors.duplicate: This item is already on the sheet.
errors.counted: Enter the counted quantity (0 or more, up to 3 decimals).
errors.costNeeded: Enter the unit cost: the system holds none of this item.

count.costOnFile: A unit cost is on file. Leave empty to keep it.

consumption.allowanceSub: Net used to the end of the selected months, against the planned quantity for each work item.
consumption.monthSub: Issued, returned and net used per month, with who issued it.
consumption.unplannedSub: Material used on a work item that has no planned quantity for it.
consumption.empty: No material issued to this project in these months
consumption.emptySub: Issues to this project's work items appear here, month by month.
consumption.errorSub: The figures are not shown rather than shown wrong. Try again.

allowance.title: Material allowance
allowance.description: Planned quantity of each stock item for {{workItem}}. Issues beyond it are allowed and flagged.
allowance.none: No allowance set for this work item yet.
allowance.quantityInvalid: Enter a quantity above 0, at most 3 decimals.
allowance.duplicate: This item already has an allowance on this work item; change it in the list.

issueOverAllowance: Over allowance: {{workItem}} has now used {{used}} of {{planned}} {{unit}} planned. The issue is posted; this is a flag, not a block.

reorder.title: Reorder levels
reorder.description: Set when each item needs ordering. A suggestion from past usage appears beside the figures; nothing changes until you accept it or save a value.

panel.title: Set a reorder level
panel.pick: Choose an item and a warehouse to see a suggestion.
panel.noCurrent: No reorder level is set here.
panel.basis: Based on {{usage}} {{unit}} used over {{days}} days ({{avg}} a day), {{lead}} days lead time plus {{safety}} days safety, and a {{cycle}}-day order cycle.
panel.insufficient: Not enough history for a suggestion. It needs at least {{minDays}} days of history and {{minMoves}} usage movements; this item has {{days}} days and {{moves}}.

worklist.title: Below reorder level
worklist.emptyTitle: Nothing is below its reorder level
worklist.emptySub: Items appear here when stock at a warehouse falls to its level.

confirmClear.title: Clear this reorder level
confirmClear.description: {{item}} at {{warehouse}} will no longer appear on the list below.

toast.failed: Could not change the reorder level

errors.levelInvalid: Enter a level of 0 or more, with at most 3 decimals.
errors.quantityInvalid: Enter a quantity above 0, with at most 3 decimals, or leave it empty.
